entries.claim_boundary: Certifies exact conditional algebraic-current laws for charged-clock comparison records on declared causal paths: primitive-basis covariance, origin independence, scoped reciprocity, matched-chain composition, loop holonomy defects, separate D/R_i/K_i actions, and the precise laws preserved by finite-resolution smearing. No nonzero receiver, physical redshift, transitivity across unmatched fibres, advanced signal, nonlinear, particle, phenomenology or quantum claim follows.

dispersion.statement: Exact comparison, orientation, charge and path-composition algebra is certified; no wave dispersion is inferred.

lee_wald.statement: A theory-specific nonradical receiver pairing is required before physical instantiation.

resonance.statement: The comparison algebra does not decide background-specific resonance.

causal_retarded.statement: Path algebra is scoped to declared retarded edges; no background-specific Green image is supplied.

smooth_secular.statement: No nonlinear secular source is supplied.

taub_maps.statement: No second-order source or nonlinear receiver is part of the theorem.
